title: MemoryRecordsListRequest
description: List records under an explicit placement selection and optional provenance filter. Authorization filters before pagination; total_authorized counts only records the principal may see (MEM-R006). Grant: records_read or recall with coverage of the selection. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

filter.description: Optional provenance filter; combines with selection by AND.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
cursor.title: Cursor
